questions.question: What are the two grammatical consequences of a noun being Ghayr Munsarif?
options: It rejects Tanwin and Damma, accepting only Fatha
It rejects all three harakaat and requires a Huruf al-Jarr in all contexts
It rejects Kasra and Tanwin — Fatha substitutes in the jarr position and Tanwin is dropped entirely
It rejects Damma and Fatha, accepting only Kasra
questions.explanation: Ghayr Munsarif rejects Kasra (replaced by Fatha in the jarr position) and Tanwin (dropped entirely in all positions).

questions.question: What is the key difference between Adl Tahqiqi and Adl Taqdiri?
options: Adl Tahqiqi always pairs with Wasf; Adl Taqdiri always pairs with 'Alamiyya
Adl Tahqiqi is deviation proven by evidence in meaning; Adl Taqdiri is deviation assumed by grammarians without external proof
Adl Tahqiqi applies to proper nouns while Adl Taqdiri applies only to descriptors
Adl Tahqiqi changes a word's meaning; Adl Taqdiri changes only its vowel pattern
questions.explanation: Adl Tahqiqi is verified deviation — there is evidence pointing to the original form, as with ثُلَاث whose repetition in meaning proves the original. Adl Taqdiri is assumed deviation — grammarians inferred the original form with no external evidence, as with عُمَر.

questions.question: What is the defining difference between Wasf Asli and Wasf Ardi?
options: Wasf Asli requires Ta'nith to function as a sabab; Wasf Ardi does not
Wasf Asli is found in Ajami words; Wasf Ardi is found in Arabic words
Wasf Asli is born with the word and retained permanently; Wasf Ardi only exists within a specific syntactic structure
Wasf Asli applies only to color adjectives; Wasf Ardi applies to all other adjectives
questions.explanation: Wasf Asli is a quality the word was designed with from the outset and retains permanently regardless of how it is later used. Wasf Ardi is a descriptor function a word only has within a specific syntactic structure — e.g., أَرْبَع as a Sifa for Niswah in that sentence, but not standalone.

questions.question: With which sabab can Adl never pair as the second cause for Ghayr Munsarif?
options: Ta'nith
Wasf
Wazn Fi'l
'Alamiyya
questions.explanation: Adl cannot pair with Wazn Fi'l as its second sabab. Adl commonly pairs with 'Alamiyya (e.g., عُمَر، زُفَر) and with Wasf (e.g., ثُلَاث، مَثْلَث).

questions.question: What does it mean for a noun to be مُنْصَرِف?
options: It accepts all three harakaat and Tanwin — it 'turns' freely through all states of declension
It rejects Tanwin in all positions
It takes Fatha in the jarr position instead of Kasra
It can only occur as the subject of a sentence, never in the jarr position
questions.explanation: Munsarif accepts all three harakaat (Damma, Fatha, Kasra) along with Tanwin; it 'turns' to all states of declension.

questions.question: As a sabab for Ghayr Munsarif, what does عَدْل refer to?
options: A grammatical assumption grammarians make when no direct evidence exists
The addition of a Ta' Marbuta to make a word feminine
Deviation from the word's original pattern (Sigha Asliyya) to a different pattern
A shift in the word's meaning from concrete to abstract
questions.explanation: Adl involves a departure from the word's original pattern (Sigha Asliyya) to a different pattern.

questions.question: Which of the following is one of the three visible markers of تَأْنِيث لَفْظِي?
options: Shadda on the final letter
Alif mamdūdah (اء)
Nun of the feminine plural (نَّ)
Waw of plural (و)
questions.explanation: The three markers of Ta'nith Lafzi are Tā' marbūṭah (ة), Alif maqṣūrah (ى), and Alif mamdūdah (اء).

questions.question: In the ayah on Tawheed al-Uluhiyyah, which two foundational acts establish Allah's exclusive right to worship?
options: Creating the angels and commanding them to serve the people of faith
Forgiving sins and answering the prayers of the believers
Bringing creation out of non-existence and abundantly bestowing blessings such as rain and sustenance
Sending prophets and revealing scriptures to guide humanity
questions.explanation: Allah alone creates and sustains — bringing creation out of non-existence and bestowing blessings like rain producing crops and fruits. Because He alone does this, He alone deserves worship.

questions.question: In Ayah al-Tahhaddi, who is included in the challenge, and what are they challenged to produce?
options: The Arabs alone; they are challenged to produce ten surahs like the Quran
All of humanity, jinn, and even the idols and false gods; they are challenged to produce a single surah comparable to the Quran
The poets of Arabia; they are challenged to produce a verse surpassing the Quran in meter
The People of the Book; they are challenged to show a scripture older than the Quran
questions.explanation: The challenge is directed at all of humanity, jinn, and the idols/false gods. They fail to produce even a single surah comparable to the Quran in rhetoric, clarity, composition, words, meanings, and legislation.

questions.question: According to Mujahid, what are الحجارة in the description of Hellfire's fuel, and why are they especially severe?
options: Stones from the mountains of this world that glow red-hot with heat
Stones engraved with the names of disbelievers, reminding them of their deeds
Stones of sulfur (كِبْرِيت), more foul-smelling and pungent than carrion, adding an olfactory torment beyond heat and flame
Stones of iron heated to extreme temperatures, used to strike the inhabitants of Hellfire
questions.explanation: Per Mujahid, the stones are of sulfur (كِبْرِيت), described as more foul-smelling and more pungent than carrion (جِيفَة). This adds an olfactory dimension to the punishment beyond heat and flame.

questions.question: Why is eternity described as تَمَامُ السَّعَادَة (complete happiness) in the tafseer of the Jannah ayah, rather than simply one more blessing?
options: Because even perfect blessings are incomplete if they can be lost — eternity removes the anxiety of death and loss entirely
Because the food and fruits of Jannah change in flavor every time they are served, ensuring perpetual novelty
Because eternal life in Jannah is the fifth and greatest blessing, ranking above the other four
Because the angels of Jannah continuously recite praises that increase the inhabitants' happiness
questions.explanation: The greatest anxiety of this life is the fear of death and loss. Jannah removes that anxiety entirely by making all its perfect blessings permanent — without eternity, even the finest blessings would remain incomplete happiness.

questions.question: What is a نِدّ, and what were the mushrikeen doing by making أَنداد for Allah?
options: A witness; they called on created things to testify to their acts of worship
A companion; they sought to draw closer to Allah through created intermediaries
An equal or rival; they set up partners alongside Allah in power and worship — the essence of Shirk
A messenger; they claimed created beings could convey divine authority independently
questions.explanation: A nidd is an equal, rival, or partner. The mushrikeen set up idols and created things as equals to Allah in power and worship, which is the essence of Shirk.

questions.question: What does the grammatical term جُمْلَة اعْتِرَاضِيَّة mean, as applied to لَن تَفْعَلُوا?
options: An exclamatory clause expressing divine judgment toward the disbelievers
A conditional clause that introduces a hypothetical scenario
A concluding statement that summarizes the main argument of the ayah
A parenthetical clause inserted within the flow of speech to reinforce a point
questions.explanation: A جُمْلَة اعْتِرَاضِيَّة is a parenthetical clause — a sentence inserted within the main flow of speech to reinforce or emphasize a point, without being the primary statement of the ayah.

questions.question: According to the majority of mufassiroon, what is similar and what is different about the fruits of Jannah described as مُتَشَابِهًا?
options: The shape, color, and appearance are similar, but the taste and quality are different each time they are served
The names are the same but the nutritional benefit is entirely different
The fruits are identical in all respects to fruits of this world, but their spiritual benefit varies
The color differs each time, but the taste is always identical
questions.explanation: According to the majority of mufassiroon, the fruits of Jannah are similar in shape, color, and appearance, but entirely different in taste and quality each time they are served.

questions.question: How does the restriction on the Quran for a woman in Haydh differ from that of a woman with only Hadas Asghar?
options: A woman in Haydh may recite silently but not aloud; a woman with Hadas Asghar may recite in any manner
Both face identical restrictions — neither may touch the text or recite from memory
A woman in Haydh cannot recite at all nor touch the text; a woman with only Hadas Asghar may recite from memory but not touch the text
A woman with Hadas Asghar cannot recite at all; a woman in Haydh may recite but not touch the text
questions.explanation: Hadas Asghar restricts touching the physical text but permits recitation from memory. Haydh is a Hadas Akbar encompassing the entire body — it prohibits recitation entirely as well as touching the text.

questions.question: Which condition for Masa on Jorabayn do thin professional/office socks most immediately fail?
options: They cannot be worn continuously for 24 hours without needing replacement
Water seeps through them, failing the water impermeability condition
They are not manufactured from natural materials such as wool or cotton
They were not a known item at the time the ruling was established by the fuqaha
questions.explanation: The first condition is water impermeability — wet hands passing over the sock must not cause water to seep through to the foot. Thin professional/office socks fail this condition immediately.

questions.question: According to Imam Abu Hanifa (Ahnaf), what are the minimum and maximum durations of Haydh?
options: Minimum 3 days and 3 nights; maximum 15 days and 15 nights
Minimum 1 day and 1 night; maximum 10 days and 10 nights
Minimum 1 day and 1 night; maximum 15 days and 15 nights
Minimum 3 days and 3 nights; maximum 10 days and 10 nights
questions.explanation: Per Imam Abu Hanifa: minimum 3 days and 3 nights, maximum 10 days and 10 nights, based on a hadith in Dar al-Qutni and Tabrani in which the Prophet ﷺ stated these parameters explicitly.

questions.question: How does the Sharia treat missed Salah and missed Sawm during Haydh?
options: Both missed Salah and missed Sawm must be made up after Haydh ends
Neither missed Salah nor missed Sawm need to be made up after Haydh ends
Missed Salah is permanently dropped with no makeup required; missed Sawm must be made up after Haydh ends
Missed Salah must be made up; missed Sawm is permanently dropped
questions.explanation: Salah is completely Saqit (dropped) — missed prayers during Haydh are permanently forgiven and never made up. Sawm is Haram during Haydh but Qada is required — missed Ramadan days must be made up, as they are far fewer and manageable.

questions.question: Under which structural modification does الجَوْرَبَيْن become fully equivalent to Khuffayn for Masa purposes?
options: When it reaches above the ankle and is secured with a strap
When it is woven entirely from sheep's wool rather than cotton or synthetic material
When it has been worn continuously for more than 24 hours without removal
When it is Mujallad (entire outer surface wrapped in leather) or Muna'al (leather applied to the sole only)
questions.explanation: Jorab becomes equivalent to Khuffayn when it is Mujallad (entire outer surface wrapped in leather) or Muna'al (leather applied to the sole only) — both structural modifications qualify it fully for Masa.

questions.question: What does سَاقِط mean in the context of Salah during Haydh, and what is its practical implication?
options: The obligation is transferred — a female guardian may perform it on her behalf
The obligation is completely dropped with no makeup required — missed prayers are permanently forgiven
The obligation is delayed — it must be performed later when the woman is in a state of purity
The obligation is reduced — only two rak'ahs are required during the recovery period
questions.explanation: Saqit means the obligation is completely lifted and permanently forgiven. Missed Salah during Haydh is never made up — a woman must not attempt to do so.

questions.question: What is the difference between مُجَلَّد and مُنَعَّل?
options: Mujallad qualifies for Masa; Muna'al does not because it lacks full coverage
Mujallad has leather only on the sole; Muna'al has leather covering the entire outer surface
Mujallad has the entire outer surface wrapped in leather; Muna'al has leather applied only to the sole
Mujallad is a type of Khuff; Muna'al is a type of Jorab
questions.explanation: Mujallad means the entire outer surface of the Jorab is wrapped in leather; Muna'al means leather is applied only to the sole. Both qualify for Masa — Muna'al has a hadith in Sunan al-Bayhaqi as its specific evidence.
